summary_en: 800,000 shares (1.34% of S/O ex-treasury) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-03 at ¥577/share ceiling; maximum ¥461.6M. Part of broader 1.6M-share (2.67% S/O) buyback programme (Aug 3 – Sep 18) combining ToSTNeT-3 block and open-market purchases. Three large shareholders (Mitsui Sumitomo Card, Mitsui Sumitomo Bank, Japan Research Institute) indicated intent to sell holdings into the block.
title_en: Notice regarding the decision on matters concerning the acquisition of treasury shares and the purchase of treasury shares via off-market transactions (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Sumiseki Holdings announced on 2026-07-31 that its board has resolved to acquire 800,000 treasury shares (1.34% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) via ToSTNeT-3 off-market transaction on 2026-08-03. The purchase price is capped at ¥577/share, with a maximum aggregate outlay of ¥461.6 million. The transaction will be executed during the 08:45 trading window on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on 2026-08-03, with results published immediately after the session closes. The company has received notification from three major shareholders—Mitsui Sumitomo Card Co., Mitsui Sumitomo Bank Co., and Japan Research Institute Co.—of their intent to sell portions of their holdings into this block. This ToSTNeT-3 block is part of a broader buyback programme authorizing up to 1.6 million shares (2.67% of S/O) and ¥1 billion total between 2026-08-03 and 2026-09-18, with any remaining balance to be acquired via open-market purchases from 2026-08-04 onwards. The buyback is aimed at enhancing shareholder returns and improving capital efficiency; the company projects a total payout ratio for FY2025 of 83.3% after this acquisition.
